method: Community picture/caption references cross-checked visually with source body sprites. Texture matching proposes candidates only; model names are not strings recovered from the Android binary.

unbound_visual_replacements.name: Lamborghini Aventador
unbound_visual_replacements.identification_basis: All 573 base frames in Original/Unbound/Underground reviewed; Unbound 086 base and eleven kit families show the Aventador family. Large side intake, long low cabin and pointed front/rear panel geometry compared with Lamborghini Aventador reference photographs. Model family only; year and trim unspecified. Earlier Huracan label corrected.

unbound_visual_replacements.name: Lamborghini Huracán
unbound_visual_replacements.identification_basis: User explicitly identified this exact extracted Unbound 188 base sprite as the Huracan in the supplied comparison image. Base and all eleven kit families reviewed; stable ID retained and mistaken Gallardo retirement reversed. Year and trim unspecified.

limitations: Identity confidence and exact-variant uncertainty are explicit.
Two original silhouettes and three Unbound hypercars remain unnamed.
Mechanical values come from the game source, not manufacturer specifications.
The mod retains the original mechanical values for its visual replacement slots.
